name: UFO STI WTF
source:
A short interactive story about an alien going to a human STI clinic for the first time.

This game was made as part of the Heartbeat Game Jam.

[From [url=https://gritfish.itch.io/ufo-sti-wtf]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个简短的互动故事，讲述了一个外星人第一次去人类性传播感染诊所的故事。

该游戏是Heartbeat Game Jam的一部分。

[来自[url=https://gritfish.itch.io/ufo-sti-wtf]itch.io[/url]]
